name: LucidFlex 50K · $1,200 daily limit
source: Account holder 2026-09-27: LucidFlex 50K with a $1,200 daily loss limit, as an option alongside plain Flex ("make the lucid flex ... lucid flex $1200 daily DD"). Every other number is LucidFlex 50K@2026-09-27's (50% consistency on top of a 2-day minimum, $3,000 target, $2,000 EOD-trailing max loss). The limit is modelled like LucidPro's: SOFT -- hit it and you are closed out and stopped for the day; the account survives. CORRECTED 2026-10-11 from Lucid's pages (https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/12945796-lucidflex-payouts, https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/11404729-allowed-trading-times): the minimum payout request is $500, every payout is capped at $2,000 (it does not rise to $2,500), and positions are closed at 16:45 ET (16:10 ET is Topstep's time).
payout_ladder: every payout: 50% of profit, at least $500 and at most $2,000; up to 5 payouts, then moved to live; 90/10 split
notes: Contract scaling (funded): start 20 micros, 30 at +$1,000, 40 at +$2,000; 4 minis = 40 micros is the hard cap (eval too). NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning when a ledger exceeds it.
Positions are closed by Lucid at 16:45 ET, no overnight holds. NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning.
Only the FIRST payout is simulated; the ladder above is informational.
Trailing max loss is measured END OF DAY, not intraday: the floor moves up with EOD peak profit and never moves down.
The floor LOCKS at +$100 once EOD profit reaches +$2,100 — from then on the account cannot be trailed below +$100.

Consistency is checked at the moment of passing: largest winning day must be <= 50% of total profit, else keep trading. Reaffirmed by the account holder 2026-09-27 -- it applies ON TOP OF the 2-trading-day minimum, not instead of it.

Payout requires 5 separate days >= $150 AND net > 0. Payout amount is 50% of profit, at least $500 (so the first payout needs >= $1,000 profit) and at most $2,000, so the max payout additionally needs >= $4,000 profit.

SOFT daily loss limit $1,200, applied per trade from each trade's tick-level worst moment (MAE): the moment the day's closed trades plus the open one reach -$1,200 you are closed out at -$1,200 and stopped for the day. Applied to the eval, the funded account and the Monte Carlo ruin walk.
NOT MODELLED: on a payout request the floor moves straight to $50,100 (only the first payout is simulated).
disclaimer: Illustrative, versioned snapshot — verify against LucidFlex's current rulebook before relying on these numbers.
